history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration intensify its efforts to expedite the development of the guidelines on joint steering committees to ensure their formalization.
history.administration_response: The Peacebuilding Support Office has previously requested closure of this recommendation and has provided the following update. The recommendation requests the development of the guidelines on joint steering committees. The Fund has developed guidance, which is available on its website, that includes a detailed template for the terms of reference of joint steering committees, outlines the relationship between the committees and the secretariat of the Peacebuilding Fund and sets out the rules of procedure, including requirements and concrete steps for the joint steering committees’ review of country strategies, project documents and reporting. The guidance is available at www.un.org/peacebuilding/sites/w ww.un.org.peacebuilding/files/docu ments/guidance_note_tors.pdf. The requested supporting documents on the establishment of the joint steering committees in 11 countries and the terms of reference are beyond the scope of the recommendation.
history.board_assessment: Given that guidance on the joint steering committees has been established, the Board considers this recommendation implemented.
